feedback.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$N=[\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{7} & 6 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $N-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
N-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{7}-\lambda  & 6 \\ 0 & 0-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(N-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(N-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{7}-\lambda  & 6 \\ 0 & -\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-\sqrt{7}-\lambda )(-\lambda )-0\cdot 6 & =0 \\ \lambda (\lambda +\sqrt{7}) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =0$ and $\lambda =-\sqrt{7}.$

**Note:** The eigenvalues of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix are the entries on the main diagonal.
